name: Accessible Design System Icon Registry
description: Curated icon registry for the accessible design system. Icons should be selected from this registry rather than chosen ad hoc.
rules: Use only icons listed in this registry unless a new reusable need is identified.
If an additional icon is definitely needed, it should be added to the registry.
Use default icon colour by default.
Use semantic icon colour tokens rather than primitive colours.
Decorative icons should be hidden from assistive technology in implementation.
Meaningful icons must have an accessible name or visible text label.
If a visible text label is associated with an icon, there is no point in the icon object itself also having a text label, as this would be redundant and create duplication in the accessibility tree.
Icon size is not the same as interactive target size.
